title: UFV-03 (AC-16): this fork assertion has not run under the real fork project
severity_rationale: S2 by the plan: an unexecuted rail assertion can hide a fork-mode leak. Capital none: no fork test runs against live funds and the bot is off.

evidence.note: Assertion: fork project rails (SPEC R4) > a Telegram send through the notifier is a recorded refusal, not a network call, and the broadcast runs (AC-16) Why not run: npm run test:fork starts Hardhat through the fork globalSetup (test/fork/setup.ts), and Phase 22 runs no Hardhat command (AC-08) Rehearsal: test/rails/vitest.fork-rehearsal.config.ts run wrapped with ETH_FORK_RPC_URL=http://127.0.0.1:9/rehearsal-marker (a dead loopback marker; nothing connected to it); axios.post spied and never called; ledger notifier-refused 2 Result: pass (vpu-20261109T021405-22636-8bff56)

sibling_sites_checked: Each entry of unrun-fork-verifications.json has one obligation. Proven meanwhile by: test/unit/rails/notifierRefusal.test.ts and test/integration/rails/notifierRefusalIntegration.test.ts plus the src-layer refusal in src/utils/notifier.ts (refuseUnderVitest)
escaped_regression: A Telegram post that reaches the network in a real fork run (for example through a code path the rehearsal never imports) would pass, because the rehearsal covers only the notifier call.
recommendation: Run it by name at the first npm run test:fork of v7.0, owner Phase 25 (ROADMAP Phase 25 success criterion 3) or any earlier phase that runs the fork suite, and record pass or fail for this named assertion.
